title: Charming Modern 3-Bedroom Home in East Nashville!
description:
Located in desirable east Nashville, relax in this modern, private, home away from home. This house is perfect for groups, families or if you’re looking for a couples getaway! Each bedroom has been thoughtfully designed and the house has a spacious backyard with a ping pong table, grill, and outdoor seating. If honky tonking on Broadway or visiting one of the many Nashville hot spots or sporting venues is on your ‘to do list’ then hop in an Uber, our house is only a few miles away from downtown!

Guest access
Our property has free parking as well as self check in.
